catalogue.lead: Every module on the platform. Take them in any order, or follow a skill path.

home.lead: Short sections teach one idea at a time. Then you use it on a machine of your own, answer the questions, and earn XP towards your next rank.
home.nothing_started: You have no module in progress. Start one from your path or from the catalogue.
home.paths_lead: Skill paths are groups of modules, in order, that build one cybersecurity skill.
home.title: Learn security by doing it

level.ask_content: It decides which skill path is suggested to you first. You can change it at any time.
level.beginner_hint: New to cybersecurity, or just starting out.
level.expert_hint: You play CTFs regularly or work in security.
level.intermediate_hint: You know the basics and have solved a few challenges.
level.label: Your cybersecurity level

machine.description: A private copy of this section's target, started only for you.
machine.extend_hint: You can extend your machine in its last 10 minutes.
machine.lifetime: It runs for an hour, and you can extend it near the end.
machine.open: Open it in a new tab
machine.other: Your machine for "{{title}}" is running. Starting this one stops it.
machine.reload_hint: It takes a few seconds to start: if the page does not load, wait a moment and reload.
machine.title: Your machine

module.completed_content: You finished every section of this module.

path.none: There are no skill paths yet.
path.not_found: There is no such skill path.
path.pick_content: A skill path is a set of modules in the right order. Enrol in one, and it stays here with your progress.

question.wrong: Not quite. Read the section again and try once more.

section.locked_content: Finish "{{title}}" first. Each section builds on the one before it.
section.locked_hint: Finish the section before it first
section.next_hint: Finish this section to open the next one.
section.questions_note: Answer every question to finish the section. Capital letters do not matter, except in flags.
